# Promotion strategy

## Audience

- Primary audience: engineers, researchers, and platform teams building or
  evaluating AI-agent observability, profiling, debugging, and audit tooling.
- Problems addressed: expensive or slow agent runs, opaque system effects,
  closed-source agent CLIs, difficult PR review, and unsafe extensions.
- Useful proof: public AgentSight commands, reproducible traces, generated
  artifacts, source code, releases, papers, and technically distinct guides.

## Channels

| Channel | Public account or community | Content format | Cadence | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Search | `agentsight.us` | durable pages, guides, comparisons, release notes | continuous | active |
| GitHub | `eunomia-bpf/agentsight` | releases, examples, source-grounded evidence | as earned | active |
| External communities | not configured | native technical material only | none | inactive |

## Operating rules

- Lead with useful native content and verifiable public evidence.
- Keep one canonical page per search intent and reader decision.
- Prefer updating an existing page over publishing a keyword-swapped duplicate.
- Do not spam, buy links, fabricate engagement, impersonate people, post
  automatically to external communities, or hide automation.
- Never store credentials, private account identifiers, emails, contacts, or
  unpublished business strategy here.
- Record any executed promotion in the corresponding daily report.

## Current campaigns

Improve discoverability of AgentSight's system-boundary observability model
through accurate, internally linked, primary-source-backed site content.
Off-site automated promotion is not authorized.
